description:
Search IOCs across all Rösti reports by text, type, tag, category and
creation time. Without filters, lists IOCs from all reports.

Each IOC carries its report id (use get_report for the report), type,
category, tags, IDS flag, comment and false-positive risk. Use lookup_ioc
or lookup_iocs to check whether specific values are known.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the next page

exact.description: Require the value or comment to equal the query instead of containing it

query.description: Text to find in IOC values or comments, e.g. 'mcrosoft' or 'C2 server'. Defanged values are refanged.

since.description: Only IOCs created or updated after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

tags.description: IOC tags, e.g. c2, phishing (see describe_taxonomy)

types.description: IOC types, e.g. domain, ip-dst, sha256 (see describe_taxonomy)

name: search_iocs

items.description: An IOC as listed by search_iocs and list_report_iocs.

entity_ref.description: IOCs with the same entity_ref belong together, e.g. hashes of one file or a domain and its IP address

false_positive_risk.description: How likely the IOC is to cause false positives (e.g. a popular, mostly benign domain).

level.description: False-positive risk level from -1 to 5; higher means more likely to cause false positives. null when Rösti has no indication of false-positive risk.

meaning.description: Meaning of the level (informational, small, moderate, medium, high, very high), or 'no indication' when Rösti has no indication of false-positive risk.

message.description: Why the risk was assigned, e.g. 'Rank 4738 on Alexa'

ids.description: Whether the IOC is suitable for intrusion detection systems

timestamp.description: When the IOC was created or last updated

type.description: IOC type, e.g. domain, ip-dst, md5, sha256, url

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page; null if there are no more

title: Search IOCs
